turns.content: Last week on Tuesday night I went from San Antonio to Irving, Texas for company training on Kisan America currency counters, which we service. The night before was stressful because I kept thinking about the week of April 28 in 2024, when I was at the same Kisan facility for five days with my previous company and felt like I did not learn anything. This time the training was only one day, taught by a knowledgeable trainer who also fixes the machines as a field service tech, and it was eye-opening and the complete opposite of the original training.
That sounds like the recent training carried the weight of the older bad experience, but turned out very differently.
What training was I stressed about recently?
